rows.what_the_ink_shows: The programme line retains the clear numeral 14, followed by live orbites written above a separately struck lower word. The margin total is visibly corrected to 1620, but its deleted predecessor and the coefficient before times 120 are heavily retraced; the original uncertainties 1500|1580 and 11 remain warranted. The cited special family visibly has 3 times 120, with 3 times 40 = 3 times 40 inserted over crossed older factors. See the four listed crops.
rows.note: The manuscript itself still says 14, whereas the row proposes the mathematical distinction of fourteen named families and sixteen orbits. Preserve the written number and existing uncertainties in the heavily overwritten total; the original already records live 1620 and 3 times 120. The exact orbit count and the cited research proofs were not independently checked. The local insertion/deletion status of orbites is handled by L1487/L1592.

events.type: used and rechecked in this run
events.outcome: Viewed the full scan, the programme line at two crop scales, the marginal total, and the special-family count. Compared these with the original LaTeX. No orbit enumeration or external proof was performed.

rows.what_the_ink_shows: Orbites is above the line in separate uncancelled strokes after the numeral 14. A thick horizontal strike passes through a different lower word, with an initial loop/stem and a long medial descender; that lower word tentatively reads paquets but is not secure. The strike is below the inserted orbites, not through it. See crops/148_scan033_L1486_words.jpg and crops/148_scan033_L1487_context.jpg.
rows.note: L1487.R1: The optical claim that orbites itself is struck out is contradicted by its position above a separately cancelled lower word. Mark orbites as inserted and retain the lower tentative reading only in deleted unsure markup. The main reader confirms a separately cancelled lower word; paquets remains a tentative reading because the crossing stroke prevents secure letter-by-letter recovery. The clear 14 is retained. This refines only the manuscript-reading claim, not the mathematical distinction between fourteen families and sixteen orbits.

events.outcome: L1487.R1 refutes only the optical assertion that orbites is cancelled: its uncancelled lettering is an insertion above another struck word. No mathematical orbit-count claim is refuted.
